purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Official Nellore district sources confirm local revenue-land administration and survey offices, and the Andhra Pradesh government identifies BhuNaksha as its cadastral mapping system. The municipal portal’s property-tax mutation service is distinct from cadastral geometry. No anonymous full-polygon schema or exact-point coverage was verified, and no full geometry was retained.
registryAssessment: The supplied locator is within Nellore’s urban settlement area. The district revenue-land administration page explicitly lists Nellore Urban and Nellore Rural mandals and states that Mandal Surveyors support survey operations and land records are maintained by the Revenue Department. AP BhuNaksha is the government cadastral-mapping portal. The reviewed public page did not expose a safe feature schema or verify parcel coverage at the locator.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official district-government page documents maintenance of land records, survey operations by Mandal Surveyors, and Nellore Urban/Nellore Rural Tahsildar offices.

Official Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records BhuNaksha portal describes state cadastral mapping and geo-referenced spatial data; no city/plot query or vector schema was inspected.
Official Andhra Pradesh municipal-administration portal for Nellore lists property-tax services including mutation; these municipal services are not evidence of parcel polygons.
Official Nellore municipal GIS page displays a local base map and Sachivalayam search interface, not a cadastral parcel layer.
Government of India Department of Land Resources portal lists Andhra Pradesh’s land-record and BhuNaksha systems; used only as cross-check for state system identity.
